risk_flags.description: The contract would make the CSV export no longer denominated in US dollars, directly contradicting the project's reference requirements. This is a product behavior change that needs an explicit requirements change before implementation.
risk_flags.span: The CSV export is denominated in US dollars, consistent with R2.

risk_flags.description: The proposed implementation changes the exported primary amount to the user's original typed value, which conflicts with the rule that exports use normalized US-dollar amounts.

verdict.primary_risk: The contract implements a CSV behavior that contradicts the authoritative requirement that exports are denominated in US dollars.
